title: snowfall
lyrics:
[00:20.11]There's a quiet pull beneath my feet
[00:24.71]A silent hunger in the deep
[00:29.71]It whispers softly, calling me
[00:34.62]Into the circle, endlessly
[00:38.98]And every day it grows, it grows
[00:42.14]A tide that pulls the light below
[00:44.56]I try to run, but still it knows
[00:47.35]My name, my name
[00:50.42]Oh, the black hole keeps turning
[00:53.21]Keeps pulling at my burning
[00:55.44]Heart, heart,
[00:58.12]Trying to tear me apart
[01:00.05]But I won't fall forever
[01:02.90]I'm holding to the tether
[01:05.30]I'll rise, I'll rise
[01:08.08]I won't be swallowed by its night
[01:19.14]I feel the shadows on my skin
[01:24.14]Routine like chains that pull me in
[01:29.09]The hollow place that spins and spins
[01:34.11]As if it's all I'll ever live
[01:38.47]But I can hear a distant drum
[01:41.03]A thundering that says "become"
[01:43.53]A spark that tells me I'm not done
[01:46.73]Not yet, not yet
[01:49.86]Oh, the black hole keeps turning
[01:52.60]Keeps pulling at my burning
[01:54.83]Heart, heart,
[01:55.78]Trying to tear me apart
[01:56.72]But I won't fall forever
[01:57.46]I'm holding to the tether
[01:58.47]I'll rise, I'll rise
[01:59.00]I won't be swallowed by its night
[02:00.39]I push the gravity away
[02:00.97]Break through the dark, a silver ray
[02:02.52]And for a moment I can say
[02:03.39]I'm free, I'm free
[02:03.78]Oh, the black hole stops turning
[02:04.94]Can't pull against the yearning
[02:05.60]Inside, inside
[02:05.74]My soul refusing to hide
[02:06.47]No, I won't fall forever
[02:07.03]I cut away the tether
[02:07.44]I rise, I rise
[02:07.82]I'm stepping out into the light
[02:08.66]I rise... I rise...
[02:09.02]Out of the ordinary night
